bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 161, Number 54 (Wednesday, April 15, 2015)]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. ROGERS of Alabama:
H.R. 1824.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Clause 1 Section 8 of Article 1 of the United States
Constitution and Amendment XVI of the United States
Constitution.
[Page H2270]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Rules, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
